narration.text: I tested 30 AI video editors, only five are genuinely useful.

At number five, we have Pictory. This tool is perfect for turning long articles or scripts into engaging videos automatically. It analyses your text, selects relevant visuals, and even adds background music, making content creation super fast.

Number four is Descript. Imagine editing your video just by editing text, like a document. Descript makes this a reality, letting you remove filler words or rearrange sections with incredible ease. It is a game changer for podcasts and interviews.

Coming in at number three is CapCut. It offers smart editing features ideal for quick, polished social videos. Its AI can automatically generate captions, remove backgrounds, and even stabilise shaky footage, all for free.

Our runner-up at number two is RunwayML. This platform provides advanced AI effects and content generation. You can use its magic tools to remove objects, generate images, or create entirely new video clips, pushing creative boundaries.

And the number one AI video editing tool is HeyGen. It lets you create incredibly realistic AI avatars and voiceovers directly from text. It is astounding for explainer videos or presentations, saving huge amounts of time and budget.
HeyGen truly stands out as the best for professional results. Did your favourite make the cut?
